metadata.title: Sofiane ASMA — Websites for small businesses & custom web apps
metadata.description: Freelance full-stack developer: professional websites for small businesses, custom web apps, dashboards and SaaS platforms.

hero.title: Professional websites for small businesses
hero.subtitle: Medical practice, shop, craft business or consultancy: I build a fast, easy-to-manage website designed to turn your visitors into customers. Custom web apps and SaaS platforms come second.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: A core offer for small businesses, plus custom development for ambitious products

items.title: Professional website development
items.description: A brochure site, a booking page or a product catalogue: a fast, clear website tailored to your business, designed to generate enquiries.

items.title: Custom web apps & SaaS
items.description: An internal dashboard, a client portal or a SaaS platform: software tailored to how you work, built with proven web technologies. Mobile apps (iOS/Android) on request.

items.title: Redesign, performance & SEO
items.description: Your current site is slow, hard to read on mobile or invisible on Google: improvements to performance, structure and organic search.

items.title: Maintenance & technical support
items.description: Updates, fixes, backups and technical advice after launch: your site or app stays reliable over time.

projects.title: Featured projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of work that reflects my technical and creative approach

items.title: Dental Clinic Management SaaS
items.description: Complete SaaS platform for dental practice management: appointments, patient records and billing.
items.focus: Practitioner-friendly UX, high data security, strong performance.
items.context: Centralising appointments, patient records and billing for a dental practice in a single tool, accessible from any browser.

items.title: Papernote
items.description: AI-powered SaaS tool for reviewing, analyzing and summarizing academic research papers.
items.focus: AI integration, fast complex document processing, clean interface.
items.context: Reading and summarising scientific papers faster: summary, detailed analysis and scoring in a single pass.
items.role: Design, full-stack development and launch, AI model integration.

items.title: MYKS Radio
items.description: Online radio web platform integrated with the Icecast API, featuring a custom video admin interface.
items.focus: Real-time audio streaming, dynamic media flow management, custom dashboard.
items.context: Streaming a radio station online and managing audio and video feeds from a custom dashboard.
items.role: Design, full-stack development and launch, custom admin interface.

items.title: Tiberium Consulting
items.description: Consulting web app with real-time messaging and a modern client-expert exchange interface.
items.context: Connecting consultants and clients through a messaging space with real-time chat, instead of emails and phone calls.
items.role: Design, full-stack development and launch, real-time features.

tech.title: Tech stack
tech.subtitle: Proven technologies to build robust, scalable products

categoryDescriptions.frontend: Modern frontend frameworks and custom design systems, built for performance and accessibility.
categoryDescriptions.backend: REST, GraphQL and real-time APIs, in Node.js, Python or Java depending on what the project needs.
categoryDescriptions.mobile: iOS and Android apps shipped to both stores, with a carefully polished UX.
categoryDescriptions.data: Relational, NoSQL and managed platforms, with schemas designed to grow with the product.
categoryDescriptions.desktop: Cross-platform desktop software in Electron, Flutter, .NET, Java or Python, from the interface down to native packaging.
categoryDescriptions.tools: Versioning, containerization and continuous delivery pipelines.

cta.title: Questions about a technology?
cta.description: I'll walk you through the benefits, trade-offs and learning curve of each option for your project.

process.title: How I work
process.subtitle: A clear, transparent method to take your project from idea to production

steps.title: Discovery & Scoping
steps.description: Needs analysis and goal definition. We align technical vision with your business challenges.

steps.title: Design & Architecture
steps.description: UX/UI mockups and tech stack selection. A solid plan before writing the first line of code.

steps.title: Agile Development
steps.description: Continuous deployment and regular demos. You see progress every sprint, no surprises.

steps.title: Delivery & Maintenance
steps.description: Production launch, SEO optimization and support. Partnership to ensure your product's longevity.
